title: FAQ: Purple Account
summary: This FAQ for the Purple Account covers a $15 monthly maintenance fee (waived with a $3,750 minimum daily balance), 0% foreign currency transaction fees, up to $30,000 travel insurance coverage, and emergency card replacements typically arriving within 2 days abroad. It also lists a $20 returned deposit fee, $0 incoming domestic wire fee, multi-currency wallet support, up to 6 complimentary airport lounge visits per year, and referral terms: earn $45 and give $35; deposit at least $1,000 within 60 days; up to 6 bonuses/year; qualify after 45 days of checking account history with Rho-Bank.
